subject: Startups
title: Stages of Startup Funding
description: A quick win: understand Stages of Startup Funding.

hook.text: Startups don't raise one check. They raise multiple rounds—each bigger, each at a higher valuation.

buildup.text: Pre-seed and seed rounds fund the idea. Series A funds the proven product. Series B and C fund scaling.

discovery.text: Each round brings new investors, higher stakes, and more dilution. Founders own less with every raise.

twist.text: Not every startup needs all rounds. Some reach profitability early. Others burn cash through Series F and beyond.

climax.text: The funding ladder is a tool, not a requirement. The best outcome is needing less money, not more.

punchline.text: Each round buys growth but sells a piece of the company.

quiz.question: What typically happens to founder ownership with each funding round?
